title: Flag docs/planning/sync-architecture-plan.md Part A as stale — its outbox-drain headline finding is now false

evidence.quote: grep for `\.drain(` in `lib/` returns zero matches outside `outbox_processor.dart` itself ... The outbox is a write-only sink in production.

why: Running the same grep today finds production callers at lib/core/sync/sync_orchestrator.dart:384 and lib/core/sync/providers/sync_orchestrator_providers.dart:200, consistent with the doc's own Phase-0 'Stop the bleeding' rollout item having shipped. The doc reads as a present-tense 'Current-state audit' with no date-of-validity caveat and is unlinked from docs/index.md, so a future contributor or AI agent (this repo runs many 'paste this prompt into a fresh session' orchestration flows) finding it via search could conclude a CRITICAL data-loss bug is still open in the most sync-sensitive subsystem in the app and misdirect effort.
recommendation: Add a 'Part A verified current as of <date>' note, or append a resolved/open marker per ranked finding — mirroring the remediation-status table pattern already used well in tracks-and-completion-bug-report.md.
acceptance_criteria: The doc states the date through which Part A's grep-based claims were last verified, or each of the 15 ranked findings carries a resolved/open marker.
